scripts.check: sync-engine check && sync-engine artifacts check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.start:backend: bun run seed && bun run sync-features && HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=4000 bun src/main.ts
scripts.dev: bun run db:up && bun run --parallel dev:backend dev:frontend
scripts.up: podman compose up -d --build && bun scripts/check-api.ts http://127.0.0.1:8080 --wait
scripts.db:shell: podman compose exec mongo mongosh -u dev -p dev
scripts.preview: bun run db:up && NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000 PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bun run start
